lessons.title: Wilhelm Wundt & The Leipzig Laboratory (1879)
lessons.description: Examine the establishment of psychology as an autonomous academic discipline in Leipzig, Voluntarism, and apperception.

lessons.title: The Method of Experimental Introspection
lessons.description: Understand Wundt's rigorous experimental self-observation, stimulus control, and the tridimensional theory of feeling.

lessons.title: Edward Titchener & American Structuralism
lessons.description: Analyze Titchener's translation of German psychology to Cornell, conscious elements, and the stimulus error.

lessons.title: Critiques & The Decline of Structuralism
lessons.description: Evaluate the fatal methodological vulnerabilities of introspection and Structuralism's enduring legacy on scientific rigor.
